# Nerva contribution

## Outcome

Describe the single user or developer outcome of this change.

## Why

Explain the problem and the evidence that motivated the change.

## Validation

List the exact commands and proof levels used. Separate automated fixtures, live Mac runtime, and physical iPad/Pencil evidence.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] The diff contains no credential, prompt, private task content, screenshot with sensitive data, complete thread ID, local path, generated OpenAI schema, or proprietary asset.
- [ ] Exact-session routing, authentication, Origin checks, idempotency, upload limits, and fail-closed behavior are unchanged or explicitly tested.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented behavior from targets and unproven hardware/runtime behavior.
- [ ] Production dependency or license changes are reflected in the generated inventory and notices.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or the exact missing evidence is stated.
